notes.title: Game development
notes.content:
August 01, 2019 Patch

- The additional way of movement in the game has changed. Now, if there is not enough space in the room, then you can move around in the game using the touchpad on the left joystick.

- Simplified gameplay. Bouncing and serving the ball has become easier. To do this, aim the ball with the touchpad on the right joystick and hit the ball.
